visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a black button-up shirt stands in a room with light-colored walls and white window blinds. He looks surprised as a cartoon face overlay appears. He begins performing exaggerated rhythmic arm stretches and marching movements while looking directly at the camera with an expressive face. (2) The man continues talking while gesturing emphatically with his hands. The scene cuts to stock footage of an athletic man in a modern gym jumping rope with intensity, then to black-and-white archival footage showing large crowds of people in white uniforms performing synchronized group calisthenics in an open urban square under natural daylight. (3) He returns to the screen, explaining history while more archival clips are shown, including children in vintage school uniforms and a historical video titled First National Health Exercise. He mimics the stiff, rhythmic movements of the old exercises before showing modern colorful footage of kids in yellow shirts doing a coordinated routine. (4) The screen transitions to a modern clip of two young women in a minimalist white studio space, wearing white crop tops and blue jeans, performing a modern pop dance routine with fluid motions. Finally, the man stands with his hands on his hips, smiling and inviting viewer engagement via the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male Mandarin speech starts immediately over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop BGM at approximately 120 BPM. A distinct digital pop SFX triggers as the cartoon overlay appears visually. A female voice asks a question with high pitch and curious intonation about health exercises. (2) The narrator's speech becomes more explanatory and narrative-focused as he discusses history. As archival b-roll plays, a layer of low-frequency ambient room tone and faint outdoor crowd murmur is introduced. A whoosh transition SFX marks the switch between various historical exercise clips. (3) The music shifts to a more dance-oriented track featuring a strong kick drum and upbeat synth melodies. It overlaps with a vocal sample of a child's voice reciting rhythmic numbers in a classroom tone. The narrator continues with a friendly, animated delivery style while explaining various exercise versions. (4) A catchy pop-rap segment in Taiwanese Hokkien plays, featuring high-arousal female vocals integrated into the background music. The male narrator's voice remains dominant in the mix with clear articulation as he reveals the origin of Lucy. The audio concludes with a final hard cut as the narrator delivers a closing call to action.
